Yogurt Banana Bread

1 large eggs
1 cup sugar

1/3 cup vegetable oil

1 cup mashed ripe bananas (2 -3

bananas) 2 teaspoons vanilla extract

1 teaspoon baking soda

1 teaspoon baking

powder 1 teaspoon

salt

2 2/3 cups All-purpose Flour 1 cup plain yogurt (low fat or fat free)

In a separate bowl, whisk together baking soda, baking powder, salt and flour. Quickly add all the dry ingredients to the banana mixture.
